title: Hearing on shared housing and related housing bills
summary: The Housing and Buildings Committee held a hearing on shared housing in New York City and considered several related bills. These include Int. 66 to legalize shared housing rooming units in new or converted buildings starting January 1, 2027, Int. 71 to require repair of trees damaged by sidewalk sheds or scaffolding, Int. 271 to expand tenant relocation notice and services after vacate orders, Int. 418 to create an in-person Housing Connect assistance program, Int. 421 to allow rental of cellar units in one- and two-family homes, and Int. 427 to change how vacant affordable units are re-listed on the housing portal.
